---
title: "Resources"
format:
  html:
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <style>
          body {
            background: #0F2143;
            color: #ffffff;
          }
          h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6,
          .meta {
            color: #ffffff;
          }
          .media-card {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
            border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
          }
          .resource-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-3px);
            box-shadow: 0 14px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
          }
          .resource-nav a,
          .resource-nav a:visited,
          .media-card a,
          .media-card a:visited {
            color: #ffffff;
            text-decoration: underline;
          }
          .media-card a:hover,
          .media-card a:focus-visible {
            color: #dbe8ff;
            text-decoration: underline;
          }
          .level2 > .media-grid {
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 245px), 1fr));
          }
          .resource-card > section {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: 2.6rem 2.4rem 2.4rem;
            gap: 0.35rem;
          }
          .resource-card > section > :is(h3, p) {
            margin: 0;
          }
          .resource-card h3 {
            display: -webkit-box;
            font-size: 1rem;
            line-height: 1.3rem;
            -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
            -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
            overflow: hidden;
          }
          .resource-card > section > p:last-child {
            align-self: end;
            font-size: 0.76rem;
            line-height: 1.2rem;
          }
          .resource-card .meta {
            color: #D4D4D4;
            font-size: 0.82rem;
            line-height: 1.2rem;
            display: -webkit-box;
            -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
            -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
            overflow: hidden;
          }
          .resource-reference-link,
          .resource-reference-link:visited {
            color: #ffffff;
            text-transform: none;
            letter-spacing: normal;
            font-size: 0.72rem;
          }
          .resource-visual {
            position: relative;
            height: 166px;
            overflow: hidden;
            isolation: isolate;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
            background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--panel-bg-a, #05070d), var(--panel-bg-b, #0f1630));
          }
          .resource-visual::before {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            z-index: 0;
            background:
              radial-gradient(circle at 18% 22%, var(--panel-glow-a, rgba(123, 97, 255, 0.3)), transparent 32%),
              radial-gradient(circle at 82% 34%, var(--panel-glow-b, rgba(255, 89, 152, 0.18)), transparent 34%),
              radial-gradient(circle at 58% 78%, var(--panel-glow-c, rgba(255, 191, 94, 0.14)), transparent 38%);
          }
          .resource-visual::after {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            z-index: 0;
            opacity: 0.24;
            background:
              repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) 0 1px, transparent 1px 28px),
              repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06) 0 1px, transparent 1px 28px);
            mask-image: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.95), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45));
          }
          .resource-visual > p {
            margin: 0;
          }
          .resource-visual-note {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0.8rem;
            left: 0.8rem;
            z-index: 4;
            color: var(--panel-note, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72));
            font-size: 0.62rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: 0.16em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
          }
          .resource-svg {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            z-index: 1;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            overflow: visible;
            pointer-events: none;
          }
          .resource-svg path,
          .resource-svg line,
          .resource-svg polyline,
          .resource-svg rect {
            fill: none;
            stroke-linecap: round;
            stroke-linejoin: round;
            vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke;
          }
          .resource-visual-stage-label {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 0.6rem;
            z-index: 4;
            color: var(--panel-note, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.68));
            font-size: 0.52rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: 0.14em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
          }
          .resource-visual-stage-label.is-left {
            left: 0.8rem;
          }
          .resource-visual-stage-label.is-center {
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
          }
          .resource-visual-stage-label.is-right {
            right: 0.8rem;
          }
          .resource-story-visual > p {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            z-index: 0;
            height: 100%;
          }
          .resource-story-visual > p > img {
            display: block;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
            border-bottom: 0;
            filter: saturate(0.94) contrast(1.04);
            transform: none;
          }
          .resource-story-visual--fit {
            background: #071528;
          }
          .resource-story-visual--fit > p > img {
            object-fit: contain;
          }
          .resource-story-visual.is-breathing-map > p > img {
            transform-origin: center;
            animation: resourceMapBreathe 5.4s ease-in-out infinite;
          }
          .resource-story-visual .resource-visual-note {
            text-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.34);
          }
          .resource-debias-visual {
            padding: 0;
            background: #ffffff;
          }
          .resource-debias-visual > p {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            z-index: 2;
            display: grid;
            place-items: center;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            margin: 0;
          }
          .resource-debias-visual img {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 3;
            display: block;
            width: min(9rem, 78%);
            height: auto;
            max-height: none;
            object-fit: contain;
            border: 0;
            border-radius: 0;
            background: #ffffff;
            box-shadow: none;
            animation: resourceDebiasBeat 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
          }
          .resource-emphasis-band {
            position: absolute;
            top: 17%;
            bottom: 15%;
            left: 52%;
            width: 14%;
            z-index: 1;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            border-left: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
            border-right: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02));
          }
          .resource-bullet {
            position: absolute;
            z-index: 2;
            left: var(--x);
            top: var(--y);
            width: var(--size);
            height: var(--size);
            border-radius: 2px;
            background: var(--bullet-color);
            opacity: var(--bullet-opacity);
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04), 0 0 var(--glow) var(--bullet-color);
            animation: resourceBulletPulse var(--duration) ease-in-out infinite;
            animation-delay: var(--delay);
            pointer-events: none;
          }
          .resource-bullet.is-outline {
            background: transparent;
            border: 1px solid var(--bullet-color);
            box-shadow: none;
          }
          .resource-bullet.is-tile {
            border-radius: 1px;
          }
          .resource-finance-visual {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 0.82fr 1.18fr;
            gap: 0.55rem;
            padding: 2rem 0.8rem 0.65rem;
          }
          .resource-finance-visual::after {
            opacity: 0.13;
          }
          .resource-finance-kpis,
          .resource-finance-panel {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
          }
          .resource-finance-kpis {
            display: grid;
            gap: 0.38rem;
          }
          .resource-finance-kpis > p,
          .resource-finance-bars > p {
            display: contents;
            margin: 0;
          }
          .resource-finance-kpi {
            min-height: 1.9rem;
            padding: 0.32rem 0.42rem;
            border: 1px solid rgba(232, 237, 247, 0.18);
            border-radius: 6px;
            background: rgba(232, 237, 247, 0.08);
          }
          .resource-finance-kpi strong,
          .resource-finance-kpi span {
            display: block;
            line-height: 1.05;
          }
          .resource-finance-kpi strong {
            color: #ffffff;
            font-size: 0.82rem;
            font-weight: 700;
          }
          .resource-finance-kpi span {
            margin-top: 0.13rem;
            color: rgba(232, 237, 247, 0.66);
            font-size: 0.48rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
          }
          .resource-finance-panel {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: 1fr 0.95fr;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            min-width: 0;
          }
          .resource-finance-bars {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
            align-items: end;
            gap: 0.32rem;
            min-height: 3rem;
            padding: 0.5rem 0.48rem 0.42rem;
            border: 1px solid rgba(232, 237, 247, 0.14);
            border-radius: 6px;
            background: rgba(12, 19, 34, 0.36);
          }
          .resource-finance-bar {
            height: var(--bar-height);
            min-height: 0.45rem;
            border-radius: 3px 3px 1px 1px;
            background: var(--bar-color);
            box-shadow: 0 0 14px color-mix(in srgb, var(--bar-color), transparent 64%);
            transform-origin: bottom;
            animation: resourceBarBreathe var(--bar-duration, 4.8s) ease-in-out infinite;
            animation-delay: var(--bar-delay, 0s);
          }
          .resource-finance-line {
            position: relative;
            min-height: 2.5rem;
            border: 1px solid rgba(232, 237, 247, 0.14);
            border-radius: 6px;
            background:
              linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 48%, rgba(232, 237, 247, 0.12) 48% 50%, transparent 50%),
              rgba(12, 19, 34, 0.28);
          }
          .resource-finance-line svg {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
          }
          .resource-finance-line polyline {
            fill: none;
            stroke: #5b9dff;
            stroke-width: 3.1;
            stroke-linecap: round;
            stroke-linejoin: round;
            filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(91, 157, 255, 0.46));
            transform-origin: center;
            animation: resourceLineBreathe 5.2s ease-in-out infinite;
          }
          .resource-finance-line circle {
            fill: #f9b54c;
            stroke: rgba(12, 19, 34, 0.9);
            stroke-width: 1.5;
            transform-origin: center;
            animation: resourcePointBreathe 5.2s ease-in-out infinite;
          }
          @keyframes resourceBulletPulse {
            0%, 100% {
              opacity: var(--bullet-min-opacity);
              transform: translate(calc(-50% - var(--drift-x)), calc(-50% - var(--drift-y))) scale(0.82);
            }
            50% {
              opacity: var(--bullet-opacity);
              transform: translate(calc(-50% + var(--drift-x)), calc(-50% + var(--drift-y))) scale(1.08);
            }
          }
          @keyframes resourceMapBreathe {
            0%, 100% {
              transform: scale(1.03);
              filter: saturate(0.94) contrast(1.04);
            }
            50% {
              transform: scale(1.09);
              filter: saturate(1.04) contrast(1.08);
            }
          }
          @keyframes resourceBarBreathe {
            0%, 100% {
              transform: scaleY(0.88);
              opacity: 0.78;
            }
            50% {
              transform: scaleY(1.08);
              opacity: 1;
            }
          }
          @keyframes resourceLineBreathe {
            0%, 100% {
              transform: scaleY(0.86);
              opacity: 0.72;
            }
            50% {
              transform: scaleY(1.08);
              opacity: 1;
            }
          }
          @keyframes resourcePointBreathe {
            0%, 100% {
              transform: scale(0.86);
              opacity: 0.74;
            }
            50% {
              transform: scale(1.22);
              opacity: 1;
            }
          }
          @keyframes resourceDebiasBeat {
            0%, 100% {
              transform: scale(1);
            }
            13% {
              transform: scale(1.055);
            }
            24% {
              transform: scale(0.985);
            }
            38% {
              transform: scale(1.035);
            }
            58% {
              transform: scale(1);
            }
          }
          .resource-diagram {
            display: block;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
          }
          .visual-coverage {
            background: #30273b;
          }
          .visual-coverage path {
            fill: none;
          }
          .diagram-guide {
            stroke: #cabbd7;
            stroke-dasharray: 4 4;
          }
          .coverage-gaps {
            stroke: #eaa9a0;
            stroke-width: 2;
            transition: opacity 300ms ease;
            opacity: 0.55;
          }
          .coverage-points {
            stroke: #ffd0ac;
            stroke-width: 7;
            stroke-linecap: round;
          }
          .resource-card:is(:hover, :focus-within) .coverage-gaps {
            opacity: 1;
          }
          .visual-pollutants {
            background: #20352f;
          }
          .pollutant-grid {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
            gap: 0.45rem;
            width: min(84%, 16rem);
            height: 74%;
            margin: 0 auto;
            top: 13%;
          }
          .pollutant-grid span {
            display: block;
            align-content: center;
            text-align: center;
            border: 1px solid #8da38d;
            border-radius: 4px;
            color: #eef5dd;
            background: #31483c;
            transition: background-color 260ms ease;
          }
          .pollutant-grid > p {
            display: contents;
          }
          .pollutant-grid span:nth-child(even) {
            transition-delay: 100ms;
          }
          .resource-card:is(:hover, :focus-within) .pollutant-grid span {
            background-color: #526749;
          }
          .visual-explorer {
            background: #eaf0df;
          }
          .exposure-focus {
            fill: none;
            stroke: #253e37;
            stroke-width: 2;
            transition: transform 320ms ease;
          }
          .resource-card:is(:hover, :focus-within) .exposure-focus {
            transform: translate(35px, -28px);
          }
          .visual-clive {
            background: #f8f5ed;
          }
          .visual-handbook {
            background: #dbe8f1;
          }
          .visual-imagery {
            background: #e9eee5;
          }
          .visual-census {
            background: #eff0f4;
          }
          .visual-atlas {
            background: #18232d;
          }
          .resource-visual:is(.visual-atlas, .visual-clive, .visual-handbook, .visual-imagery, .visual-census) > p > img {
            object-fit: contain;
            filter: none;
          }
          .visual-handbook > p > img {
            padding: 0.4rem;
            transition: transform 300ms ease;
          }
          .resource-card:is(:hover, :focus-within) .visual-handbook img {
            transform: perspective(400px) rotateY(-13deg);
          }
          .resource-card:is(:hover, :focus-within) .visual-atlas img {
            transform: scale(1.06);
          }
          .resource-card:is(:hover, :focus-within) .visual-clive img {
            filter: saturate(1.35);
          }
          .resource-card:is(:hover, :focus-within) .visual-bias-story img {
            filter: saturate(1.1) contrast(1.18);
          }
          .resource-card:is(:hover, :focus-within) .visual-imagery img {
            transform: translateX(-3%) scale(1.1);
          }
          .resource-card:is(:hover, :focus-within) .visual-census img {
            filter: contrast(1.23);
            transform: translateY(-3%);
          }
          .resource-card:is(:hover, :focus-within) [data-scene="logistic"] .resource-emphasis-band {
            border-color: #b65b45;
          }
          .resource-card:is(:hover, :focus-within) [data-scene="composition"] .resource-svg path {
            opacity: 0.9;
          }
          @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            .resource-card,
            .resource-visual *,
            .resource-visual *::before,
            .resource-visual *::after {
              transition: none;
            }
            .resource-card:is(:hover, :focus-within),
            .resource-card:is(:hover, :focus-within) .resource-visual img,
            .resource-card:is(:hover, :focus-within) .exposure-focus {
              transform: none;
            }
            .resource-bullet,
            .resource-story-visual.is-breathing-map > p > img,
            .resource-debias-visual img,
            .resource-finance-bar,
            .resource-finance-line polyline,
            .resource-finance-line circle {
              animation: none;
            }
            .resource-bullet {
              transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            }
          }
          @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .resource-visual {
              height: 148px;
            }
            .resource-finance-visual {
              padding-top: 2rem;
              gap: 0.45rem;
            }
            .resource-finance-kpi {
              padding: 0.28rem 0.36rem;
            }
            .resource-finance-kpi strong {
              font-size: 0.74rem;
            }
          }
        </style>
---

  class="resource-visual resource-finance-visual"
  aria-hidden="true"
  style="--panel-bg-a: #0f1729; --panel-bg-b: #16213e; --panel-glow-a: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.24); --panel-glow-b: rgba(91, 157, 255, 0.20); --panel-glow-c: rgba(249, 181, 76, 0.14);"

<script>
window.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const panels = [...document.querySelectorAll(".resource-visual[data-scene]")];
  if (!panels.length) return;

  const svgNamespace = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  const clamp = (value, min, max) => Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));

  const mulberry32 = (seed) => {
    let state = seed >>> 0;
    return () => {
      state += 0x6D2B79F5;
      let t = state;
      t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
      t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    };
  };

  const svgEl = (name, attributes = {}) => {
    const node = document.createElementNS(svgNamespace, name);
    Object.entries(attributes).forEach(([key, value]) => {
      node.setAttribute(key, String(value));
    });
    return node;
  };

  const createSvg = (panel) => {
    const svg = svgEl("svg", {
      class: "resource-svg",
      viewBox: "0 0 100 100",
      preserveAspectRatio: "none",
      "aria-hidden": "true"
    });
    panel.appendChild(svg);
    return svg;
  };

  const appendLine = (svg, x1, y1, x2, y2, options = {}) => {
    svg.appendChild(svgEl("line", {
      x1,
      y1,
      x2,
      y2,
      stroke: options.stroke || "rgba(255,255,255,0.35)",
      "stroke-width": options.strokeWidth || 1,
      opacity: options.opacity ?? 1,
      "stroke-dasharray": options.dasharray || ""
    }));
  };

  const appendPath = (svg, points, options = {}) => {
    const pathData = points
      .map(([x, y], index) => `${index === 0 ? "M" : "L"} ${x.toFixed(2)} ${y.toFixed(2)}`)
      .join(" ");

    svg.appendChild(svgEl("path", {
      d: pathData,
      stroke: options.stroke || "rgba(255,255,255,0.7)",
      "stroke-width": options.strokeWidth || 1.4,
      opacity: options.opacity ?? 1,
      "stroke-dasharray": options.dasharray || ""
    }));
  };

  const appendRect = (svg, x, y, width, height, options = {}) => {
    svg.appendChild(svgEl("rect", {
      x,
      y,
      width,
      height,
      rx: options.rx ?? 1.2,
      ry: options.ry ?? 1.2,
      fill: options.fill || "none",
      stroke: options.stroke || "rgba(255,255,255,0.18)",
      "stroke-width": options.strokeWidth || 0.9,
      opacity: options.opacity ?? 1
    }));
  };

  const createBullet = (panel, options, random) => {
    const bullet = document.createElement("span");
    bullet.className = "resource-bullet";

    if (options.outline) bullet.classList.add("is-outline");
    if (options.tile) bullet.classList.add("is-tile");

    bullet.style.setProperty("--x", `${options.x.toFixed(2)}%`);
    bullet.style.setProperty("--y", `${options.y.toFixed(2)}%`);
    bullet.style.setProperty("--size", `${options.size.toFixed(2)}px`);
    bullet.style.setProperty("--bullet-color", options.color);
    bullet.style.setProperty("--bullet-opacity", `${options.opacity.toFixed(2)}`);
    bullet.style.setProperty("--bullet-min-opacity", `${Math.max(0.14, options.opacity * 0.45).toFixed(2)}`);
    bullet.style.setProperty("--glow", `${(options.glow ?? 10).toFixed(2)}px`);
    bullet.style.setProperty("--drift-x", `${(options.driftX ?? ((random() - 0.5) * 1.8)).toFixed(2)}px`);
    bullet.style.setProperty("--drift-y", `${(options.driftY ?? ((random() - 0.5) * 1.8)).toFixed(2)}px`);
    bullet.style.setProperty("--duration", `${(options.duration ?? (4.2 + random() * 2.8)).toFixed(2)}s`);
    bullet.style.setProperty("--delay", `${(options.delay ?? (-random() * 5.4)).toFixed(2)}s`);

    panel.appendChild(bullet);
  };

  const createPanelLabel = (panel, text, className) => {
    const label = document.createElement("span");
    label.className = `resource-visual-stage-label ${className}`;
    label.textContent = text;
    panel.appendChild(label);
  };

  const renderCountScene = (panel, random, colors) => {
    const svg = createSvg(panel);
    const bins = [2, 4, 7, 10, 13, 11, 8, 5, 3];
    const topPoints = [];

    appendLine(svg, 12, 84, 90, 84, { stroke: "rgba(255,255,255,0.24)", strokeWidth: 0.9 });
    appendLine(svg, 12, 18, 12, 84, { stroke: "rgba(255,255,255,0.24)", strokeWidth: 0.9 });
    appendLine(svg, 51, 22, 51, 84, {
      stroke: colors[3] || colors[2] || "#ffd166",
      strokeWidth: 0.9,
      opacity: 0.35,
      dasharray: "2.2 2.2"
    });

    bins.forEach((height, index) => {
      const x = 18 + index * 7.6;
      const colorIndex = clamp(Math.round((index / (bins.length - 1)) * (colors.length - 1)), 0, colors.length - 1);
      const baseColor = colors[colorIndex] || colors[0];

      for (let row = 0; row < height; row += 1) {
        createBullet(panel, {
          x: x + (random() - 0.5) * 0.8,
          y: 79 - row * 5.1,
          size: 7.1,
          color: row === height - 1 ? (colors[3] || baseColor) : baseColor,
          opacity: 0.38 + (row / Math.max(height, 1)) * 0.46,
          glow: 10 + row * 0.8,
          driftX: 0,
          driftY: (random() - 0.5) * 0.9,
          duration: 4.6 + random() * 1.8,
          tile: true
        }, random);
      }

      topPoints.push([x, 78 - (height - 1) * 5.1 - 2.4]);
    });

    appendPath(svg, topPoints, {
      stroke: colors[1] || "#ffffff",
      strokeWidth: 1.8,
      opacity: 0.92
    });

    topPoints.forEach(([x, y], index) => {
      createBullet(panel, {
        x,
        y,
        size: 4.5,
        color: index === 4 ? (colors[3] || colors[2] || "#ffd166") : (colors[1] || "#ffffff"),
        opacity: 0.9,
        glow: 12,
        driftX: (random() - 0.5) * 0.6,
        driftY: (random() - 0.5) * 0.6,
        duration: 3.8 + random() * 1.4
      }, random);
    });

    for (let index = 0; index < 12; index += 1) {
      createBullet(panel, {
        x: 14 + random() * 74,
        y: 82 + random() * 4,
        size: 3.2 + random() * 2.2,
        color: colors[0] || "#778dff",
        opacity: 0.18 + random() * 0.16,
        glow: 6,
        driftX: (random() - 0.5) * 0.4,
        driftY: (random() - 0.5) * 0.4,
        duration: 5.4 + random() * 1.8,
        tile: true
      }, random);
    }
  };

  const renderLogisticScene = (panel, random, colors) => {
    const svg = createSvg(panel);
    const band = document.createElement("span");
    band.className = "resource-emphasis-band";
    panel.appendChild(band);

    appendLine(svg, 12, 84, 90, 84, { stroke: "rgba(15,33,67,0.22)", strokeWidth: 0.9 });
    appendLine(svg, 12, 18, 12, 84, { stroke: "rgba(15,33,67,0.22)", strokeWidth: 0.9 });

    const curvePoints = [];
    for (let step = 0; step <= 32; step += 1) {
      const x = 16 + (68 * step) / 32;
      const probability = 1 / (1 + Math.exp(-(x - 50) / 7.8));
      const y = 78 - probability * 52;
      curvePoints.push([x, y]);
    }

    appendPath(svg, curvePoints, {
      stroke: colors[2] || colors[3] || "#ff5a4f",
      strokeWidth: 1.8,
      opacity: 0.9
    });

    curvePoints.forEach(([x, y], index) => {
      if (index % 4 !== 0) return;
      createBullet(panel, {
        x,
        y,
        size: 4.3,
        color: "#ffffff",
        opacity: 0.7,
        glow: 8,
        driftX: (random() - 0.5) * 0.5,
        driftY: (random() - 0.5) * 0.5,
        duration: 4 + random() * 1.4
      }, random);
    });

    for (let index = 0; index < 36; index += 1) {
      const x = 18 + random() * 66;
      const probability = 1 / (1 + Math.exp(-(x - 50) / 8));
      const positive = random() < probability;
      let y = positive ? 22 + random() * 16 : 66 + random() * 14;

      if (positive && x < 42 && random() < 0.18) y = 34 + random() * 8;
      if (!positive && x > 58 && random() < 0.18) y = 56 + random() * 8;

      createBullet(panel, {
        x,
        y,
        size: 5 + random() * 3.2,
        color: positive ? (colors[3] || colors[2] || "#ff5a4f") : (colors[0] || "#85b8ff"),
        opacity: 0.42 + random() * 0.34,
        glow: positive ? 13 : 10,
        driftX: (random() - 0.5) * 1.2,
        driftY: (random() - 0.5) * 1.2,
        duration: 4 + random() * 2.2,
        outline: random() > 0.88,
        tile: true
      }, random);
    }
  };

  const renderCompositionScene = (panel, random, colors) => {
    const svg = createSvg(panel);
    const before = [5, 4, 3];
    const after = [3, 5, 4];
    const centers = { left: 24, right: 76 };
    const rowHeight = 4.8;
    const barWidthOffsets = [-2.8, 0, 2.8];
    const beforeMidpoints = [];
    const afterMidpoints = [];

    createPanelLabel(panel, "before", "is-left");
    createPanelLabel(panel, "migration", "is-center");
    createPanelLabel(panel, "after", "is-right");

    appendRect(svg, 18.2, 22.2, 11.6, 58.2, {
      stroke: "rgba(255,255,255,0.16)",
      strokeWidth: 0.9,
      opacity: 0.9
    });
    appendRect(svg, 70.2, 22.2, 11.6, 58.2, {
      stroke: "rgba(255,255,255,0.16)",
      strokeWidth: 0.9,
      opacity: 0.9
    });
    appendLine(svg, 40, 51, 60, 51, {
      stroke: colors[3] || colors[2] || "#fde68a",
      strokeWidth: 1,
      opacity: 0.3,
      dasharray: "2.5 2.5"
    });

    const drawBar = (segments, centerX, midpointStore, mode) => {
      let rowCursor = 0;

      segments.forEach((rows, segmentIndex) => {
        const yMid = 78 - (rowCursor + (rows - 1) / 2) * rowHeight;
        midpointStore.push([centerX, yMid]);

        for (let row = 0; row < rows; row += 1) {
          const y = 78 - (rowCursor + row) * rowHeight;
          barWidthOffsets.forEach((offset, laneIndex) => {
            const sizeJitter = laneIndex === 1 ? 0.6 : 0;
            const isIncoming = mode === "after" && segmentIndex === 1 && row >= rows - 2;
            createBullet(panel, {
              x: centerX + offset + (random() - 0.5) * 0.28,
              y: y + (random() - 0.5) * 0.28,
              size: 6.8 + sizeJitter,
              color: isIncoming ? (colors[3] || colors[2] || "#fde68a") : (colors[segmentIndex] || colors[0]),
              opacity: 0.48 + segmentIndex * 0.1 + (mode === "after" ? 0.04 : 0),
              glow: isIncoming ? 15 : 9 + segmentIndex * 2.4,
              driftX: (random() - 0.5) * 0.7,
              driftY: (random() - 0.5) * 0.7,
              duration: 4.6 + random() * 1.9,
              tile: true
            }, random);
          });
        }

        rowCursor += rows;
      });
    };

    drawBar(before, centers.left, beforeMidpoints, "before");
    drawBar(after, centers.right, afterMidpoints, "after");

    beforeMidpoints.forEach(([x1, y1], segmentIndex) => {
      const [x2, y2] = afterMidpoints[segmentIndex];
      const bendX = 50;
      const bendY = (y1 + y2) / 2 + (segmentIndex - 1) * 4.4;
      const flowColor = colors[segmentIndex] || colors[0];
      const flowPoints = [[x1 + 6, y1], [bendX, bendY], [x2 - 6, y2]];

      appendPath(svg, flowPoints, {
        stroke: flowColor,
        strokeWidth: 1.35,
        opacity: 0.34
      });

      [0.2, 0.45, 0.7].forEach((t, index) => {
        const x = flowPoints[0][0] + (flowPoints[2][0] - flowPoints[0][0]) * t;
        const y = flowPoints[0][1] * (1 - t) * (1 - t)
          + 2 * (1 - t) * t * flowPoints[1][1]
          + flowPoints[2][1] * t * t;

        createBullet(panel, {
          x,
          y,
          size: 4.5 + index * 0.35,
          color: flowColor,
          opacity: 0.58 + index * 0.08,
          glow: 10 + index * 1.8,
          driftX: 0.7 + index * 0.3,
          driftY: (random() - 0.5) * 0.5,
          duration: 3.8 + random() * 1.2,
          tile: true
        }, random);
      });
    });

    const migrantLaneY = [38, 47, 56];
    migrantLaneY.forEach((y, laneIndex) => {
      [0.1, 0.32, 0.56, 0.8].forEach((t) => {
        createBullet(panel, {
          x: 40 + t * 20 + (random() - 0.5) * 0.6,
          y: y + Math.sin((t + laneIndex * 0.2) * Math.PI) * 1.8,
          size: 4.1 + random() * 0.8,
          color: colors[3] || colors[2] || "#fde68a",
          opacity: 0.5 + random() * 0.18,
          glow: 11,
          driftX: 0.9,
          driftY: (random() - 0.5) * 0.35,
          duration: 3.5 + random() * 1.2,
          tile: true
        }, random);
      });
    });
  };


  panels.forEach((panel, panelIndex) => {
    const random = mulberry32(Number(panel.dataset.seed || panelIndex + 1));
    const colors = (panel.dataset.palette || "")
      .split(",")
      .map((value) => value.trim())
      .filter(Boolean);
    const scene = panel.dataset.scene || "count";

    if (scene === "count") {
      renderCountScene(panel, random, colors);
    } else if (scene === "logistic") {
      renderLogisticScene(panel, random, colors);
    } else if (scene === "composition") {
      renderCompositionScene(panel, random, colors);
    }
  });
});
</script>
